race.comment: SIR LOYNE (1) is a horse who showed good talent early in his career in Sydney and has been in the market at his couple of runs for the new stable but failed to threaten, the latest effort a modest fifth at Tatura over 1450m. He hasn't seen a race of this quality, though, so he must be given another chance. SIMPLY EXCELS (2) last appeared when he finished eighth over 1300m at Stawell on May 18. Rates highly and makes plenty of appeal in this company. CHOSEN VENTURE (5) far from ideal being drawn out with the big weight, but comes out of a BM62 race and won in this grade the start prior. Going well enough to feature. POPTHEBUBBLY (9) made progress last time out, finishing 3.5 lengths from the winner in third at the end of 1400m at Hamilton. Has her share of talent and looks hard to beat in this suitable race. KAMEZALI (3) was out of the money when resuming from a spell last start over 1100m at Bendigo, beaten 5.5 lengths. Fitter so expect a better run this time.
